info.title: Zelda Save Editor (Beta)
info.author: StockiestThree9
info.description: Native BOTW save editor with profile management
info.details: Public beta for Breath of the Wild on the original Nintendo Switch family. Edit hearts, stamina wheels, inventory, equipment, horses and advanced fields with undo/redo and verified backups. Includes Normal, transferred Profile 2 and Master Mode tabs, normal-only profile swapping, console-sourced navigation sounds and OLED black mode. Requires Atmosphere and application-mode homebrew with access to your installed BOTW resources. Launch Sphaira over BOTW by holding R for resource access, then close BOTW before editing. Keep an independent backup. Gameplay after profile swaps and wider device save-and-reload validation remain unverified; shared album and compendium pictures stay in place during swaps. Tested real-save fixture: BOTW 1.9.0. No Nintendo assets, private saves or extracted game resources are included.

changelog: First public beta: native interface, Quill & Scroll icon, compact game picker, normal-only Profile 1/Profile 2 swaps with full backups and recovery, separate Master Mode, and Auto/Light/Dark/OLED appearance.
